name: model-complete-retry-stderr
about: serve 起服务，比服务进程自己的 stdout / stderr。preq（openai）与 pgoog（google）两个 provider 都设 timeoutMs 600、requestMaxRetries 2、baseDelayMs 1，标题请求挂 1.5 秒：openai 分支每次超时后重试，基线 complete() 在重试前 console.warn「[PilotDeck] complete() retry: <消息> (attempt n/max, delay=Nms)」（streamModel.ts:127-130，Google 分支是 108-111）到 stderr，三次都失败后 SessionTitleGenerator.ts:97、196-200 在 stdout 打 console.debug「[session-title] generation skipped (provider_error): …」；google 分支这里是标题自己的中止（This operation was aborted，isRetryableRequestError 不重试），只有 skipped 一行。之后四个会话的标题应答分别是空白、坏 JSON、带代码围栏但没有 title、title 全是空白：empty_content / invalid_json（带 JSON.parse 的报错）/ missing_title / missing_title。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
    preq:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/preq/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      timeoutMs: 600
      retry:
        requestMaxRetries: 2
        streamMaxRetries: 0
        baseDelayMs: 1
      models:
        m:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
    pgoog:
      protocol: google
      url: {MOCK}/pgoog
      apiKey: bbx-google-key
      timeoutMs: 600
      retry:
        requestMaxRetries: 2
        streamMaxRetries: 0
        baseDelayMs: 1
      models:
        m:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
